text: The Quick Inventory of Depressive Symptomatology (QIDS) is a useful, validated measure of depressive symptoms that covers the DSM-IV diagnostic criteria for major depressive disorder. The Japanese translation of the QIDS (QIDS-J) has been published, but its psychometric properties have not been validated in large samples.
source_label: Assessing depression among the Japanese population: psychometric properties of the Japanese version of Quick Inventory of Depressive Symptomatology-self-reported version
